remarks: Experience luxury living at its finest with this exquisite Completely Renovated 2 Bedrooms Ranch Style Condo set back in a quiet enclave conveniently located just minutes to Restaurants, Train, Parks, and movie theater. Built with the best finishes in mind, the flexible open floor plan centers around your gourmet kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and breakfast area that opens to the family room with large-pane oversized glass sliders and Juliette balconies overlooking the beautifully manicured back yard perfect for grilling/entertaining. Exquisite mill work, Hardwood floors, and custom floating shelves truly show meticulous attention to detail. Enjoy the two large Bedrooms, closets with custom organizers, laundry closet and absolutely spectacular spa inspired bathroom featuring a walk-in shower with floating bench, custom vanity, and frameless glass door. new roof, driveway/parking area with plenty of guest parking, extra 10x10 storage room, and very low HOA fees. This unit is not to be missed!
